title: Fedwire — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Fedwire is the Federal Reserve's real-time gross settlement system, in which each wire settles individually and immediately. Domestic wires usually complete within hours, are effectively final, and cost roughly 25 to 50 dollars. This overview edition presents Fedwire as a core payments concept in modern banking.

spec.how_it_works: Instructions travel a payment rail, clear through network windows, and settle finally into the receiver's account.
spec.real_world_use: United States: Real-estate closings and legal settlements use Fedwire for same-day finality.
spec.risk_notes: Standard controls apply: verification, monitoring, reconciliation, and documented compliance procedures.
spec.typical_costs: Costs vary by institution and usage; compare published fee schedules and compute effective cost under realistic volumes.
spec.source_note: Core facts verified from public sources.
